description: Matches a reading topic against subject phrases and related-word rules for J.A. Watte's six-book catalog. A match returns a title, a topic-based reason, and links. Only a clearly matched subject receives a book. An unmatched topic returns no book and no Amazon link. This searches only the publisher's own catalog.

topic.description: The reader's situation, goal or topic, in their words.

name: recommend_book
